name: Budget control and encumbrance tracking workbench
description: User opens the budget management workspace, views department allocated vs encumbered amounts, and exports budget status to Excel.

planSteps.description: Navigate to Budgets under the Finance section in the main navigation menu
Verify the Budgets workbench loads displaying department budget cards with progress indicators for encumbered and remaining funds
Switch to the Encumbrances tab to inspect active purchase order encumbrance log entries
Verify encumbrance table displays document reference, status, initial amount, and remaining balance
